title: IVG Original Salts Strawberry Watermelon 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Original Salts Strawberry Watermelon 10ml E-Liquid combines two of vaping’s most beloved fruits into a balanced, everyday blend. The sweet, rich notes of fresh Strawberries form a smooth foundation, while the light, crisp, and slightly cooling taste of Watermelon adds a refreshing lift. This combination ensures a consistent, well-rounded fruit profile that feels familiar yet distinct, making it an excellent all-day vape for those who prefer straightforward fruit flavours. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal balance of discreet vapour production and clear, intense flavour. IVG Original Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The IVG Original Salts collection is inspired by the brand’s most successful flavour profiles, offering vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and dessert blends. Beyond the classic pairing of Strawberry Watermelon, vapers can explore other stellar options like the zest-forward Summer Blaze or the complex Forest Berries Ice. Every e-liquid in this collection is designed to provide a high-quality, authentic experience for mouth-to-lung vapers.
